settings.title: Specifications of the 2000 mm Export Glass Washing Machine
settings.text:
Why is a suitable glass washing machine essential for double-glazed glass production?
Anyone who has visited a double-glazed glass production line will recognize that the glass washing machine is one of its most important machines. If the inner glass surfaces have stains or dirt, cleaning them easily after the double-glazing process is complete is no longer possible.
This is a serious concern for many double-glazing manufacturers. As a result, full-option glass washing machines are used in Iran and around the world to ensure that the inner surfaces of double-glazed units are clean and clear.
One of the most advanced machines offered by Kara Trading Group is the full-option 2000 mm glass washing machine, an export-grade model.
There are generally two types of glass washing machines suitable for double-glazed glass: vertical and horizontal models.
This machine is fitted with premium-quality components, and its electrical equipment is manufactured in France. A key feature of the 2000 mm model is its ability to wash two glass panes simultaneously, making it sought after in domestic and international markets.
Another notable feature is the 8 cm nano-sponge foam in the drying section, which can absorb approximately 98% of water.
Its effective washing dimensions are 3.21 × 2 m.
To prevent watermarks after washing, the machine is equipped with a high-pressure hot-air centrifugal blower. Although powerful, it operates quietly and can remove up to 100% of residual moisture from the glass surfaces.
The sponge movement speed across the glass can be adjusted using the speed-control section. The machine also includes a quality-control section to ensure high-standard washing and drying.
Operating safety is another key consideration when buying an export-grade, full-option glass washing machine. Kara Manufacturing Group equips this machine with two emergency-stop buttons, one at the infeed and one at the outfeed, to enhance safety.
Some buyers worry that a 2000 mm glass washing machine may scratch glass during washing. However, its scratch-resistant brushes use nanotechnology to help prevent scratches and marks.
For greater strength, the machine body is made from 2 mm thick steel sheets. All components are standard, first-grade parts. The body is also finished in a two-stage electrostatic powder-coating oven process.

settings.title: Important Points to Consider When Buying a Glass Washing Machine
settings.text:
Considering several key points when purchasing a glass washing machine can help you make a confident choice that meets your requirements.
The most important considerations include:
Washable dimensions: These machines are generally classified according to the maximum glass dimensions they can wash. This is one of the most important factors to consider before purchasing.
Glass thickness range
Glass washing machines typically handle glass thicknesses ranging from 2 to 20 mm, so this range is an important purchasing consideration.
Number and type of brushes
The number and type of brushes, as well as the density of their bristles, can significantly affect cleaning quality. This factor should therefore be carefully considered when selecting a glass washing machine.
